platform: CIMcloud (classic ASP storefront, Knockout.js front-end); images on CloudFront CDN https://dehbblwvl33hy.cloudfront.net/images/
catalog_endpoint: https://morrisproducts.com/pc_product_detail.asp?key=helper&ajax=get-product-by-sku&skus=SKU1~SKU2~... (JSON, used by the site's own front-end; accepts many SKUs per call, returns sku, name, thumb/pic/largePic filenames, link, parents)
est_products: Unknown (no sitemap.xml - returns 404 page; no product count observed)
sku_format_match: yes - Morris SKUs are the numeric/alpha catalog numbers (89757, 14917, T200CBPK); Lumera list prefixes numeric SKUs with an apostrophe (Excel text marker) which must be stripped. 12 of 12 samples returned.
recommended_strategy: Strip leading apostrophe from Lumera SKUs, then call the JSON endpoint in batches (e.g. 25-50 SKUs joined with '~', 1 req/sec). For each product take largePic (fallback pic) and build URL as 'https://dehbblwvl33hy.cloudfront.net/images/' + filename.lower() (the site's buildImagePath lowercases; uppercase filename returned 404). largePic images observed at 900x900 JPEG. Note many child SKUs share the parent family image (e.g. 14917 -> 14910_l.jpg).
